segments.text: Teacher at Seitei Gakuen, in charge of Japanese.
She is Takaya's former homeroom teacher and Akane's mother. She is an exemplary teacher who is passionate about education and always puts her students first.

Takaya, a former student of hers, unexpectedly confesses his love to her, but Yumiko is already married. Her husband is Shiro Kazama, a teacher at another school, and they already have an adolescent daughter.

However, Yumiko could not shake off Takaya's straightforward romantic feelings, by the time Takaya graduated from the school, he had completely taken her husband's place in her heart. And now, despite being a married woman, her voluptuous body and youthful beauty,
makes the students, who are conscious of their older age, strongly aware of women.

When she meets Takaya again, she finds that he still has the same affection for her as he did back then, she is attracted to Takaya, and her heart is troubled as she tries to be a “wife”, a “mother”, a “senior teacher”, and a "woman".
From DLsite
聖貞学園教師。担当は国語。
主人公の元担任教師。紅音の母親。既婚者で、夫は同行の教頭・風祭志郎。
教育熱心で、生徒のことを最優先に考える模範的な教師。
教え子だった主人公に愛の告白を受け、それを振り切ることが出来ずに、一度だけ性交渉に及んだ過去を持つ。
人妻であり、年齢的にも中年層に入っていながらも、その肉感的な肢体と若々しい美貌は、学園の男子学生たちに羨望と欲望を抱かせる。
再会した主人公が、あの頃と変わらぬ想いを持っていることを知り、教師として、人妻として、女として、大いに責め悩ませる。
聖貞学園教師、国語担当。主人公（三波鷹矢）の元担任、紅音の母親。
教育に熱心、学生のことを常に最優先する模範的な教師。教え子だった鷹矢から思いもかけない愛の告白を受けるも由美子は既に結婚をしていた。
夫は他校の教師である風祭志郎、そしてすでに思春期の娘がいた。
しかし鷹矢のストレートな恋愛感情を由美子は振り切ることができず、鷹矢が学園を卒業する頃には
完全に心の中に彼の居場所ができてしまっていた。
そして現在、人妻でありながらもその肉感的な肢体と若々しい美貌は、年上を意識する学生たちに女を強く意識させる。
再会した鷹矢があの頃と変わらぬ愛情を持っていることを知り、
惹かれていく心と“人妻”として“母親”として“先輩教師”としてあろうとする心が彼女を責め悩ませる。
A second-year student at Seitei Gakuen.

Daughter of Yumiko, she is an individualistic and manipulative person who is a modern girl. She has noticed that her parents are not getting along well, and even though she respects her mother, she criticizes her relationship with her father, saying that she needs to rethink her relationship with him.

Her youthful body, which is beginning to mature from a “girl” to a “woman,” is very attractive to men. Akane falls in love at first sight with Takaya, a trainee teacher, but she discovers his feelings for Yumiko. With a faint sense of rivalry with her mother, she tells Takaya of her feelings for him, hoping to turn his attention to her.
From DLsite
聖貞学園二年生。由美子の娘。
主人公が担当することになったクラスの女子学生。
美人の母親に似て、非常に整った顔立ちで、スタイルも“少女”から“女”へと成長し始めている。
しかし、現代っ子ならではなのか、個人主義的な性格を持ち、勝手気ままに他人を振り回す。
両親の夫婦仲が冷めていることに気付いており、尊敬する母親に対して、父親との関係を見直すべきと痛烈に批判している。
教育実習にやってきた主人公に一目惚れするが、その主人公が母親・由美子への想いを隠し持っていることを知り、母親への対抗意識を燃やして主人公に熱烈なアプローチをかける。
聖貞学園２年生。
由美子の娘、現代っ子ながらの個人主義で他人を振り回す性格。
両親の仲が冷えているのは気付いており、母親のことは尊敬していても父親との関係は見直すべきと批判している。
“少女”から“女”に実り始めた初々しい肢体は男心をそそる。
実習生の鷹矢に一目惚れするも、由美子への気持ちを知ってしまった紅音は、
母親へのほのかな対抗意識もあって鷹矢の気持ちを自分に向けるべく好意を伝える。

segments.text: He is a university student who has been assigned to an educational internship at his old school, Seiteii Gakuen. He is in charge of social studies.

In high school, Takaya was attracted to his homeroom teacher, Yumiko Kazama, and fell in love with her. She was already engaged to a fellow teacher, but Takaya's innocence could not be ignored, and on graduation day, he confessed to Yumiko.
Takaya's love for Yumiko remains in his heart even after he leaves for higher education. Takaya, who had the same desire to become a teacher as Yumiko, entered university.

By coincidence, his teaching internship took place at Seitei Gakuen, where he met Yumiko again. Takaya is reunited with Yumiko, and in his class, Yumiko's daughter, Akane Kazama, is enrolled, and their relationship deepens.
From DLsite
Husband of Kazama Yumiko and father of Akane. He is more than 10 years older than Yumiko.
At the time of their marriage, he was a teacher at another school, but last year he started working as the vice principal at Seitei Gakuen.
He has already lost his sexual desire for women, and his relationship with Yumiko is almost sexless. He is a strict man and strictly enforces school rules and student management.
Compared to his decline through the years, he is nervous about his white cheating on him, whose beauty does not match her age.
